fields.label: Marketplace Order ID
fields.description: The marketplace-issued order number (e.g. Shopify SQ-440390821, B2B/2438421785483405985). The primary join key against Settlement Line.marketplace_order_id in the recon engine. Uniqueness enforced per (marketplace, marketplace_order_id, company) in controller validate().

fields.label: Marketplace
fields.description: Flat channel list. Half of the composite uniqueness key. Drives recon Rate Card / Settlement Template resolution downstream.

fields.label: Marketplace Account
fields.description: The specific Marketplace Account (per-Company × per-Marketplace) the order was pulled through. Distinguishes multi-account setups on the same marketplace (e.g. two Amazon FBA accounts).

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Third element of the composite uniqueness key. Enables permission_query_conditions to scope Maps to the user's companies (§31.8.3 pattern).

fields.label: EasyEcom Order ID
fields.description: EE's internal numeric order id (data.orders[].order_id from getAllOrders). Distinct from marketplace_order_id (which is the marketplace's own reference).

fields.label: Settlement Status
fields.description: Recon engine (ecommerce_super_recon) writes this. Forecast (default at Map creation) → Partial → Settled | Disputed. Ecommerce_super never writes anything except the initial Forecast at Map creation time.

fields.label: Expected Settlement Date
fields.description: Computed at Map creation from marketplace-specific SLA (via Recon Marketplace Settings.pending_window_days). Recon may update on partial settlement. Used by Net Receivables view (PRD §10.3.1) to age unsettled orders.

fields.label: Settlement Completed At
fields.description: Recon writes this when settlement_status transitions to Settled. Immutable thereafter.

fields.label: Recon Writeback
fields.description: All fields in this section are written by the recon engine (ecommerce_super_recon). Empty on non-recon sites.

fields.label: Actual Net Settlement
fields.description: Populated by the Recon module. Sum of settled amounts from Settlement Lines matched to this order's SIs.

fields.label: Variance Amount
fields.description: Populated by the Recon module. actual_net minus expected_net (from expected-payout engine).

fields.label: Variance %
fields.description: Populated by the Recon module. variance_amount as a percentage of expected_net.

fields.label: Total Shipments
fields.description: Auto-computed from len(shipments) in controller validate(). Denormalised for query performance (list view + Net Receivables grouping).

fields.label: Shipments
fields.description: One row per Sales Invoice for this marketplace order. Handles split-shipment cases (one marketplace order → many EE invoice_ids → many ERPNext SIs). Every EE metadata field (invoice_id, invoice_number, manifest_date, batch_id, invoice_currency_code, sales_channel, payment gateway, IRN cross-ref, e-way bill cross-ref) lives on the child, keeping row-size impact on tabSales Invoice at ZERO.
